title: The Hidden Trail
summary: Find a clue tucked into a hidden directory.
description: Linux filenames that begin with a dot are hidden from an ordinary `ls` listing. Follow the directory tree and inspect the clue without changing the supplied evidence. Write the clue into `.evidence/hidden-trail.txt`.
learning_objectives: Use find to locate a nested clue

workspace_seed.README.txt: Hidden files and nested paths practice.

offline_hints.title: Think about the concept
offline_hints.content: A file can be present even when a plain directory listing does not show it.

offline_hints.title: Investigate this area
offline_hints.content: Try `ls -la`, `find . -type f`, and inspect the directories you discover.

offline_hints.title: Guided route
offline_hints.content: The clue is in `.cache/field/route.txt`. Copy its single clue line into `.evidence/hidden-trail.txt`, creating the `.evidence` directory first. The clue text is `PATH-ORCHID-47`.

completion_explanation: You completed The Hidden Trail. Review the evidence, compare the observed result with the expected state, and explain why it matters in a real defensive workflow.

network_requirements.description: No network interface is required for this mission.
